messages:
Nora (Design): quick feedback request: should we put unit suffixes on axis ticks (e.g., 1.2k) or show a global axis suffix (e.g., 1.2 · k at corner)? mocked both.
Imran (Eng-Frontend): global suffix is easier to render and keeps ticks tidy. per-tick suffixes add layout jitter on narrow screens.
Hannah (DataViz): global suffix helps compare tick alignment but can hide per-tick scaling nuance. propose global suffix + per-tick tooltip showing full raw value.
Ola (PM): product note: customers asked for explicit byte units (IEC vs SI). can we expose a small unit picker: SI | IEC | Raw? default = SI.
Nora (Design): UI idea: tiny kebab in axis corner -> "Units: SI / IEC / Raw" and a tooltip: "SI = k, M. IEC = Ki, Mi for bytes." shows selected suffix on axis corner.
Imran (Eng-Frontend): accessibility nit: picker must be reachable by keyboard and have aria-haspopup, role=menu. focus ring needed. Also add persistent aria-label for axis that reads full unit e.g., "Throughput in megabytes per second".
Hannah (DataViz): smoothing + clipping interactions: if smoothing is on, we should not clip pre-smoothed values. clip applied to raw series, but legend should show a small "smoothed" chip when smoothing enabled.
Nora (Design): legend microcopy: "Latency — ms" vs "Latency — milliseconds" (aria only). in-legend toggle for smoothing and a small "(3 clipped)" count that opens axis expansion.
A11yBot: reminder: clipped count button needs accessible name e.g., "Expand axis, 3 values clipped" and aria-live update when axis expands or collapses. Track ticket #821.
Imran (Eng-Frontend): backend needs to return series_meta: ["clipped_count", "clamp_percentile", "preferred_unit"] so frontend can surface counts and suggested unit. will gate percentile compute behind sampling flag.
Hannah (DataViz): visual for clipped points: chevron marker on-dot + faint hashed band above clamp. prefer soft-clamp at 99th pct by default, with option to show full range.
Ola (PM): rollout plan: 1) axis unit picker + global suffix, 2) legend smoothing chip + clipped count, 3) clamp visuals + a11y sweep. ship behind FF and gather user feedback.
